title: Größen & Schutzraum / Medium
slide_intent: Keep the same margin while changing the icon drawing so medium-size controls retain clear separation.
strategic_value: A defined medium variant can keep DB interface symbols crisp and aligned.
demonstration: The Medium tab compares a 24×24 dp plus-circle at actual size with an enlarged 20×20 dp live area inside a 2 dp margin.
practical_value: Use the medium asset and its 2 dp margin rather than reducing the large drawing without checking its construction.
